content.comment_body: Hello all, I have a question regarding the [product_name] module [article_no]. The [product_name] is powered normally, and I've connected it to my PC via an Ethernet cable. I use the IP address 192.168.0.80 to access the web server using Google. Initially, everything works fine, but after a few minutes the network disconnects and I can no longer work with the web server due to the lost connection. Does anyone know why this might be happening? I've experienced this with two different [product_name] modules, so I think it might be normal.

Hello, If you're configuring the [product_name], consider these points: 1. If other devices and a router are in the network, ensure fixed IP addresses (like for [product_name], other modules, etc.) are outside the router's DHCP range. 2. Confirm no other device in the network uses the same IP address. Hope this helps.

Hi, Everything is working now, thank you! The issue was an existing device in the network using the same IP address. The advice: "Ensure no other device in the network uses the same IP address" resolved it.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered intermittent loss of network connectivity when accessing the web server hosted on the [product_name] Communication Interface Module. The problem stemmed from an IP address conflict on the local network, which disrupted reliable access to the module's web interface. Resolving the IP conflict restored stable operation, emphasizing the need for effective network configuration when setting up web-enabled modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect uninterrupted access to the [product_name] module's web server after initial connection and power-up. The web interface should stay accessible for ongoing configuration and monitoring tasks.
